jobs.title: Business Product Manager, Treaty Administration and Claims products.
jobs.location: United States, Chesterfield, MO, RGA HQ
jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies , we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

A Brief Overview

The Product Manger (PM) is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Treaty Administration and Claims products.. Working at the Sub-Domain or Business Level, the Product Manager ensures that products deliver business value, customer impact, and market differentiation. They own the relationship with Business Leadership and External Customers, while collaborating closely with Product Owners, Engineering and Design to align product strategy with market demands and customer needs. They ensure a successful product launch by defining and executing a go to market plan. The Product Manager is accountable for defining business cases, prioritization frameworks, and value-driven decision-making to optimize the product's success.

This role is open to any RGA office in the USA

What you will do

- Defines the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a product or group of products while serving as the face of the product, communicating the vision and roadmap to the organization and ensuring alignment across leadership, teams, and external partners while considering customer needs, market trends, and business objectives.
- Partners with leadership to develop business cases and ensure proper funding.
- Engages with customers, conducts market research, and competitive analysis to inform product direction.
- Works closely with Product Owners to translate strategy into an actionable roadmap through a refinement of features and backlog priorities.
- Leads cross-functional alignment with engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success teams and facilitates cross-functional planning and trade-off discussions by working closely with engineering and design teams to ensure feasibility and user-centric development.
- Owns the product roadmap by balancing technical constraints, business objectives, and customer needs while ensuring alignment with business goals and market needs.
- Defines key success metrics (OKRs, KPIs) and continuously tracks product performance including customer adoption, retention, and market impact to inform future enhancements.
- Advocates for iterative, hypothesis-driven approach to product development.
- Influences decision-making to ensure product decisions are data-driven and support business growth utilizing strategic insights and compelling storytelling.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) MBA or relevant field preferred
- 6+ Years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or a related role
- Experience managing a single product or multiple related products within a portfolio
- Experience working with stakeholders, engineering teams, and business leaders to define and execute product strategies. required
- Experience managing product Profit & Loss, pricing strategies, and go-to-market execution.
- Strong understanding of Agile, Lean Product Development, and user-centered design principles.
- Strong ability to define product vision and roadmap based on business and market needs.
- Expertise in prioritization frameworks for backlog management. Deep understanding of Agile, Lean Startup, and Customer Development methodologies.
- Exceptional ability to influence cross-functional teams and leadership.
- Strong negotiation and facilitation skills to drive alignment on product direction.
- Comfortable presenting product roadmaps, trade-offs, and decisions to executives and customers.
- Strong experience conducting customer research, competitive analysis, and market validation.
- Ability to translate qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.
- Proficiency in A/B testing, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.
- Strong understanding of technical architecture, APIs, and cloud-based software development.
- Ability to partner with engineering teams to make informed trade-offs.

#LI-MJ1  #LI-HYBRID

What you can expect from RGA:
- Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

- Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

- Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you.

Compensation Range:

Base pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and market location. In addition, RGA provides an annual bonus plan that includes all roles and some positions are eligible for participation in our long-term equity incentive plan. RGA also maintains a full range of health, retirement, and other employee benefits.

RGA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, gender identity or expression, sex, disability, veteran status, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Digital Product Solutions
jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies , we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

Job Objective

As the lead for RGA’s reinsurance digital product solutions, this role is responsible for driving the strategy, development, and commercialization of our digital underwriting solutions embedded with RGA’s reinsurance offerings. The role ensures our digital products are positioned as core enablers of reinsurance value for targeted clients, supporting RGA’s market-leading position while meeting long-term sustainability, governance, and regulatory requirements.
The role bridges business strategy and execution to maximize the scalable impact of digital solutions across markets, enhance client engagement and underwriting outcomes, and ensure all digital products are designed with strong compliance, data protection, and risk management foundations.

Key Responsibilities

Commercialization & Client Enablement
- Embed RGA’s digital underwriting products into reinsurance solution strategies, positioning as integral components of client-facing reinsurance offerings rather than standalone products.
- Drive commercialization and adoption by aligning product strategy with targeted client segments, business development priorities, and market needs.
- Ensure digital solutions are designed to seamlessly complement reinsurance structures, supporting clients in product launches, underwriting decision-making, and operational transformation.
- Partner closely with Business Development to co-lead client engagements, pitches, onboarding, and solution customization, enabling product launches and long-term client partnerships.

Value Maximization, Scale, and Market Leadership
- Scale and maximize the value of RGA’s digital underwriting solutions by leveraging proprietary platforms and data‑driven capabilities to transform underwriting at scale, strengthening efficiency, consistency, risk management outcomes, and RGA’s market‑leading reinsurance position.
- Own the end-to-end digital product lifecycle, from strategic vision, roadmap development through execution, commercialization, and performance optimization, ensuring measurable business impact and sustainable returns on investment.

- Continuously incorporate market intelligence, client feedback, and performance metrics to refine product, prioritize enhancements that strengthen RGA’s differentiation.
- Act as a thought leader and internal advocate for digital underwriting and reinsurance innovation, influencing strategy and execution, within the organization and across the industry

Governance, Compliance, and Long-Term Sustainability
- Partner with legal, compliance, risk, and information security teams to uphold RGA’s enterprise risk management framework and protect client and policyholder data, embedding compliance, security, and sustainability by design across all digital products.
- Establish strong product governance and lifecycle controls to balance innovation with risk, supporting audit readiness, operational resilience, scalability, and long‑term maintainability.

Requirements
- University degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
- 15+ years of relevant experience in project management, consulting, or large‑scale transformation initiatives.

- Proven experience operating at the intersection of commercial strategy, product execution, and enterprise risk management in financial services or insurance industry

- Strong understanding of how digital products optimize carrier workflows, underwriting efficiency, and risk management outcomes.

- Strategic planning and execution experience, including ownership of product roadmaps and delivery governance.
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business needs into practical, scalable solutions.
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, trade‑offs, and risks effectively.
- Proven leadership capability, including the ability to lead, motivate, and develop high‑performing, collaborative teams.
- Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Effective change management and customer relationship management capabilities.
